provides.label: MRtrix3 影像阈值处理
provides.description:
独立调用 MRtrix3 3.0.8 的 mrthreshold；保留原软件计算，参数按原版本帮助定义。

Create bitwise image by thresholding image intensity
The threshold value to be applied can be determined in one of a number of ways:
- If no relevant command-line option is used, the command will automatically determine an optimal threshold;
- The -abs option provides the threshold value explicitly;
- The -percentile, -top and -bottom options enable more fine-grained control over how the threshold value is determined.
The -mask option only influences those image values that contribute toward the determination of the threshold value; once the threshold is determined, it is applied to the entire image, irrespective of use of the -mask option. If you wish for the voxels outside of the specified mask to additionally be excluded from the output mask, this can be achieved by providing the -out_masked option.
The four operators available through the "-comparison" option ("lt", "le", "ge" and "gt") correspond to "less-than" (<), "less-than-or-equal" (<=), "greater-than-or-equal" (>=) and "greater-than" (>). This offers fine-grained control over how the thresholding operation will behave in the presence of values equivalent to the threshold. By default, the command will select voxels with values greater than or equal to the determined threshold ("ge"); unless the -bottom option is used, in which case after a threshold is determined from the relevant lowest-valued image voxels, those voxels with values less than or equal to that threshold ("le") are selected. This provides more fine-grained control than the -invert option; the latter is provided for backwards compatibility, but is equivalent to selection of the opposite comparison within this selection.
If no output image path is specified, the command will instead write to standard output the determined threshold value.

input_slots.label: input
input_slots.description: the input image to be thresholded

input_slots.label: 掩膜
input_slots.description: compute the threshold based only on values within an input mask image

output_slots.label: 输出：影像阈值处理
output_slots.description: the (optional) output binary image mask 文件名由平台固定在本次输出目录内。

parameters.label: 阈值确定方式
parameters.description: 只启用所选方式对应的原软件选项；其他方式的草稿值不会传入命令。

parameters.label: 绝对强度阈值
parameters.description: specify threshold value as absolute intensity
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。
parameters.condition_help: 当前所选方式需要此参数。

parameters.label: 百分位阈值
parameters.description: determine threshold based on some percentile of the image intensity distribution
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。
parameters.condition_help: 当前所选方式需要此参数。

parameters.label: 保留最高值体素数
parameters.description: determine threshold that will result in selection of some number of top-valued voxels
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。
parameters.condition_help: 当前所选方式需要此参数。

parameters.label: 保留最低值体素数
parameters.description: determine & apply threshold resulting in selection of some number of bottom-valued voxels (note: implies threshold application operator of "le" unless otherwise specified)
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。
parameters.condition_help: 当前所选方式需要此参数。

parameters.label: allvolumes
parameters.description: compute a single threshold for all image volumes, rather than an individual threshold per volume

parameters.label: ignorezero
parameters.description: ignore zero-valued input values during threshold determination

parameters.label: comparison
parameters.description: comparison operator to use when applying the threshold; options are: lt,le,ge,gt (default = "le" for -bottom; "ge" otherwise)
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。

parameters.label: invert
parameters.description: invert the output binary mask (equivalent to flipping the operator; provided for backwards compatibility)

parameters.label: out_masked
parameters.description: mask the output image based on the provided input mask image

parameters.label: nan
parameters.description: set voxels that fail the threshold to NaN rather than zero (output image will be floating-point rather than binary)

parameters.label: quiet
parameters.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.

parameters.label: CPU 线程数
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.software_default: 未设置时不传入该选项；默认行为以 MRtrix3 3.0.8 原始说明为准。
